title: Expression parsing (java)
description: Java code parses an expression string with parser.parseExpression. Spring Expression Language evaluates method calls and property access, so an expression built from untrusted input can run code on the server. This lexical rule flags the parse call; the reviewer confirms the string is fixed or uses a fixed expression with variables bound through SimpleEvaluationContext.
remediation: Parse only fixed expressions. Evaluate user-influenced data through a fixed expression with variables bound through SimpleEvaluationContext and keep user input out of the expression text.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the parse call regardless of where the string came from.
